The Subtask Name: Determine the directors of both films and their death dates

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer

  -- Thought: Needed to confirm the directors to compare their death dates
  -- Result: Identified Luis César Amadori and Henry Wulschleger as the directors

- Agent: WebSurfer
